name: untrusted event text reaching a shell in a workflow

files..github/workflows/deploy.yml:
name: Deploy
on:
  issues:
    types: [opened]
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  greet:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: echo "New issue: ${{ github.event.issue.title }}"

expect.because: An issue title is written by whoever opened it. This is remote code execution with a token attached.

name: a container that drops back to root

files.Dockerfile:
FROM node:22-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY . .
RUN npm ci
USER root
CMD ["node", "dist/server.js"]

expect.because: Running as root is the default nobody chose. Choosing it explicitly is worth a comment.

name: a workflow with no permissions block

files..github/workflows/ci.yml:
name: CI
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: npm test

expect.because: With no permissions block the job gets the repository default, often write on everything.
actions/checkout@v4 is a tag, and a tag can be moved by whoever owns it.

name: a correctly locked-down workflow is silent

files..github/workflows/lint.yml:
name: Lint
on:
  pull_request:
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@b4d893f40445585b467e9f731215b3e648f95c52
      - run: npm run lint

forbid.because: It declares its permissions. Reporting it anyway teaches people the fix does not help.
Pinned to a full commit SHA, which is the fix for a mutable ref.
